CLASSIFIER_1.where: A.comps is built from the archive's compressed component rows, which carry the online id, and identity_intervals keys its per-step cell sets by that id.

inputs_it_uses: the world Y total from the step array
what_it_recomputes: the components, by toroidal single-linkage at CORE_R from coordinates alone
the centroids, from the cell sets
the per-component Y occupancy, by summing the cell rows
the identity links, the episodes, the maturation gates, the identity intervals and their event content
CLASSIFIER_2.algorithmic_independence: components are closed by label propagation to the per-row minimum, not by union-find. Both formulations are implemented and checked against each other.

THE_ONE_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY.quantity: the local X disc mass xd
THE_ONE_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY.why_it_cannot_be_recomputed: the narrow archive stores the X field only on Y-occupied cells, and the frozen gate sums X over an 81-cell disc most of which is not Y-occupied.
THE_ONE_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY.how_it_is_obtained: read from the archive's component rows and attached by matching (centroid, ncells, nY) — a physical match. No component id is used to make the match.
THE_ONE_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY.what_would_expose_a_problem: a non-bijective match, which is counted below and is zero.
THE_ONE_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY.what_it_affects: only GATE_local_x_ratio in M3. The component structure, M2, the identity intervals and the event step do not depend on it.

REQUIRED: 100 % agreement on M2, M3, M5 and the event step
WHAT_THIS_ESTABLISHES: that every number FIMRCC01 will read out of an archive can be produced without trusting the online component bookkeeping. It does not establish that the endpoint is the right one, and it does not establish anything about reproduction, heredity, life or autonomous cohesion, in the affirmative or in the negative.
